steps.pick: Take the contract and ask Orik what kind of beast leaves those marks.
Head down the shore track to the southern cove now.
Walk straight onto the lower pier in plain sight.
Share a cup of brandy by the brazier while waiting for the beast's wake.
Set your cup down and join her on the folded blankets behind the crates.
Leave the loft and slip back to Millstow to prepare.
